title: Memo from New Delhi: Make America India Again?
content: Donald Trump proposed renaming New Mexico to New America, claiming it would enhance pride among residents and change election integrity. Political representatives from New Mexico opposed the idea, emphasizing the state's historical significance and established name. Constitutional barriers exist, as name changes require formal processes involving local and national laws. Historical context surrounding America’s naming is complex and reflects a mix of cultural influences.

title: Why India slipped in Asian Games standings despite 24 medals as China extend lead
content: India achieved 24 medals, achieving five golds on Day 2 of the Asian Para Games 2026. Nishad Kumar and Deepthi Jeevanji led the country with outstanding athletic performances, contributing significantly to the medal tally. Despite this notable success, India's ranking dropped from fourth to sixth due to the gold medal count. China continued to lead the standings with a significant gap over competing nations.

title: 65-year old swimmer killed in shark attack off South African coast; 2 beaches shut
content: Tragedy struck at Orient Beach in KuGompo City when 65-year-old open-water swimmer Janine Lochrenberg was fatally attacked by a shark. Despite the desperate efforts of fellow swimmers who rushed to assist her, she suffered life-threatening injuries to her arm and thigh, ultimately succumbing to her wounds. In response, local authorities promptly closed the beach and launched an investigation, as reports indicate a slight rise in shark attacks in recent years.

title: Watch: UP MLA Raja Bhaiyya worships 500+ guns on Dusshera
content: Raja Bhaiya conducted a Shastra Puja ceremony at his Benti Palace, displaying more than 500 weapons. His twin sons participated alongside block chiefs and hundreds of supporters carrying licensed weapons. This tradition has been observed since ancient times, emphasizing India's cultural heritage. Controversy arose earlier regarding alleged illegal weapons, which Raja Bhaiya's aide denied. Both sons have become increasingly involved in political activities since joining the Jansatta Dal (Loktantrik).

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
content: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

title: Trump ‘frustrated and angry’ says Rubio; rejects reports of shift in Ukraine policy
content: US secretary of state Marco Rubio reaffirmed the ongoing weapons assistance and intelligence sharing with Ukraine during his visit to India. He expressed frustration regarding the lack of progress in negotiations to end the conflict, emphasizing the situation's urgency. Rubio clarified that the US had not denied Ukraine critical interceptors, which are in high demand globally.

title: Does Trump’s 60-day tariff waiver really give relief to India?
content: For India, the immediate relief is for its crude supply basket and exporters. If India decided to give up Russian crude oil, its single largest supplier would have gone off the table, with no easy replacement amid Middle East tensions. If it continued to buy Russian crude, then the 100% tariffs would have weighed on its exports to the US.

title: Georgia court upholds verdict voiding stepson's home deed, $57,600 award
content: In a complex property dispute, a woman in Georgia transferred her property interest to her stepson during a period of cognitive decline. Her guardian, suspecting exploitation and fraud, pursued legal action, leading to a jury decision that invalidated the transfer and awarded damages. The stepson contested this ruling, alleging jury misconduct. However, the appeals court decided to uphold the initial verdict, solidifying the guardian's victory.

title: 1867 $5 gold coin found in Texas cigar box sells for $97,600
content: A remarkable 1867-S Liberty Half Eagle gold coin was unearthed from an obscure closet in Texas, boasting a staggering value of $97,600. This highly sought-after coin, a valuable heirloom of a Union soldier, shattered previous auction records. Experts praised its rarity and condition, sparking intense competition among collectors. After a thrilling auction, the coin found its new home in a private collection, bringing its extraordinary journey to a close.

title: Polling for bill that may push out billionaires from California nears: What data shows
content: Proposition 40 seeks to introduce a wealth tax in California targeting those with fortunes over $1 billion. However, recent surveys show a downturn in public support as contributions from opposing groups soar. Significant financial backing from notable tech leaders has created a stark contrast, with opposition efforts raising around $340 million, overshadowing the measure's supporters. The fate of this important referendum will be decided on November 3.

title: Kentucky sinks 1,700 discarded Christmas trees in lake to shelter fish
content: Kentucky collected around 5,000 discarded Christmas trees in 2026 to restore underwater habitats in its ageing lakes. As part of the state's 'Christmas for the Fishes' programme, approximately 1,700 trees were submerged in Boltz Lake alone. The trees provide shelter and feeding areas for fish, replacing natural structures that have decayed over time. The initiative also helps improve recreational fishing opportunities.

title: BJP’s delimitation gambit: Will it isolate Cong, puncture opposition’s SIR unity?
content: As the government gears up for a new delimitation effort, Congress’s quest for opposition unity faces hurdles. Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge raised alarms about the government's legislative strategies pertaining to delimitation and reservations for women. With Kiren Rijiju hinting at discussions across various opposition factions that may favor the bills, the scenario presents a complex web of political dynamics.

title: WWE accused of disrespecting John Cena by referencing Nikki Bella’s past

Their differing views on marriage and children ultimately led to their breakup. Recently, WWE brought their past into Nikki's ongoing rivalry with Paige, facing backlash from Jonathan Coachman, who deems it disrespectful toward Cena, now happily married.

title: Qing dynasty bowl spent 87 years in Chicago museum, then sold for $2.048m
content: A stunning porcelain bowl from the Qing dynasty recently fetched $2.048 million at a Christie's auction. Crafted during Emperor Yongzheng's reign, the bowl is adorned with auspicious symbols, hinting it was a birthday gift for the emperor. After decades in the Art Institute of Chicago, the proceeds will fund new acquisitions and conservation efforts. This sale is part of a lucrative two-day auction dedicated to Chinese art.

His standout performances were instrumental in clinching the Knicks' first championship in 53 years during the thrilling 2026 NBA Finals. As the reigning NBA Finals MVP, Brunson heads into the 2026-27 season with great expectations and strategic acquisitions surrounding him.

title: Asian Para Games: India’s medal storm! 24 medals, 5 golds as Nishad, Deepthi shine

Notable athletes like Nishad Kumar and Deepthi Jeevanji achieved outstanding performances in their respective events. Additionally, the nation has secured medals in shooting, powerlifting, and swimming. With more medals expected in archery and badminton, India is building a strong campaign.

title: CJP's Das, Ranka seek urgent night hearing against extension of judicial custody

They were placed in extended judicial custody after being detained for entering Jantar Mantar illegally. The Cockroach Janta Party claims that the delay in bail proceedings is intentional to keep them imprisoned. CJP representatives argue that their clients should not remain behind bars due to political motivations.

title: Women are earning, but who controls their money? India's financial literacy divide
content: In India, numerous women face challenges in making financial decisions due to insufficient access to essential financial knowledge and limited participation. Although more women are starting to utilize financial services, many still lack involvement in crucial financial decisions. This insecurity is often rooted in societal norms and traditional gender roles. Studies indicate that women who participate in financial literacy programs significantly boost their confidence and understanding.

title: After days on the run, influencer Shraddha Dubey arrested in UP bizman death case
content: Lucknow Police, along with Nagpur Police and the STF, have arrested Shraddha Dubey, her sister Rashmi, and driver Tanveer Ali. The three were wanted in connection with the death of restaurant owner Shiva Sharma. Shiva Sharma died on October 9 after falling from a fourth floor apartment building in Lucknow. The arrests occurred in Nagpur where the trio had been evading capture.

title: PM Modi invokes 'Ram Rajya' on Dussehra, warns against people hurting India's image
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Dussehra celebrations and highlighted the importance of public welfare. He emphasized the need for social justice and self-reliance as central to national development. Modi reminded attendees of the ideals of Lord Ram, focusing on justice and equal opportunities. He encouraged recognizing India's potential while serving the poor and marginalized. The Prime Minister referenced Vijayadashami as a celebration of the triumph of good over evil.

title: Barbara Hutton's Rolls-Royce survived prince's fatal crash, sold for £166,750

Following a tragic accident that claimed the prince's life, the exquisite vehicle was returned to Hutton for repairs. It changed hands multiple times before making its way to the United States in the 1970s.

Their financial activities also include a reported $100 million podcast deal, property investments and business partnerships, alongside questions about foundation spending and charitable transparency.

title: Air India Express flight suffers bird strike, lands safely in Bengaluru
content: An Air India Express flight en route from Bhogapuram to Bengaluru encountered a bird strike on Monday, yet all 148 passengers and crew emerged safely. Following the event, technical teams diligently inspected the aircraft, confirming it was in good condition for future flights. Notably, a comparable bird strike event affected an Emirates flight just days earlier on October 17.

title: Iran faces rising threat as Baloch rebels step up attacks amid regional war pressure
content: Iran is grappling with escalating security issues fueled by assaults from Baloch separatists and Sunni militants. The People's Fighters Front has ramped up its operations in Sistan and Baluchistan, resulting in a rising number of casualties. In response, Iranian authorities are mobilizing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps to combat these threats.

title: Burqa-clad, e-rickshaw clue: How cops tracked down model Shraddha Dubey
content: Nagpur police used an e-rickshaw clue to track and arrest Shraddha Dubey and her associates. They fled from Uttar Pradesh and were located after a 24-hour surveillance operation. The operation was assisted by local intelligence and CCTV footage analysis. Shraddha claimed her innocence in a video but is suspected of involvement in a murder case. Police are examining circumstances surrounding the death of Shiva Sharma after the arrests.

title: The backstory: When West 'tricked' Russia to overthrow Gaddafi's regime in Libya
content: The beginning of the end of Gaddafi's regime began at the UN security council, where Russia, the United States, Britain, France and China can each block a decision with a veto. However, the regime's fate in Tripoli was sealed with a trick. On March 17, 2011, with Gaddafi’s forces turning their guns on rebels in Benghazi, the council voted on Resolution 1973.

title: 'Will happen shortly': Rubio on US trade deal; calls India 'refining superpower'

He expressed confidence in finalizing a trade deal and recognized India's vital position in refining Venezuelan oil. Furthermore, Rubio tackled military assistance to Ukraine and stressed the need for arms control conversations involving China and Russia, illustrating the deepening geopolitical ties between the United States and India.

title: Double gold, Games record! Nishad Kumar joins elite Indian club with historic feat
content: Nishad Kumar made history by winning his second gold medal at the Asian Para Games 2026. He clinched the men's high jump T47 title with a record jump of 2.04m. This victory follows his gold in the long jump T47 event, where he achieved a best of 7.11m. Nishad's achievements make him one of only three Indians to secure two golds in a single Asian Para Games edition.

title: UK football club boss faces £100k legal battle over 24ft garden room built in 2018

Justin Salmon altered the structure after a tribunal found it breached his lease, but neighbour Andrianna Neophytou says the changes are insufficient and wants it demolished. Legal costs could exceed £100,000.

title: Toledo's 1897 rail bridge, bought for $1, now set for $65m overhaul

Key structural enhancements will enable the bridge to support heavier railcars, thereby improving efficiency in transportation. The project, backed by substantial federal funding alongside contributions from Wheeling & Lake Erie Railway, underscores a dedication to bettering rail infrastructure and strengthening ties with local port facilities.

title: Only known portrait of Bahadur Shah Zafar's adviser sold for £63,500

Created between 1851 and 1852, this significant painting not only depicts a key religious figure but also highlights his profound spiritual essence. The artwork exceeded auction projections, underscoring its historical value. Interestingly, the back of the painting features sketches of boats, adding to its artistic allure.

title: Historic high! India win record five bronze medals in best-ever para TT show

With Ravi Baby Sahana and Prachi Pandey marking a significant first in the standing category, and impressive contributions from Bhavina Patel and Jehan Madan, this feat highlights India's expanding footprint in para table tennis.

title: Britain sends Typhoon fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthis

The UK is set to deploy RAF Typhoon jets and prolong its air-to-air refuelling mission by an additional 90 days. British aircraft will play a crucial role in the defense of Saudi cities and vital installations, alongside sending military transport aircraft and advisors.

title: Marco Rubio In Mumbai For 3-Day India Visit, Trade Deal Talks On Agenda
content: The visit of the US Secretary of State, who is accompanied by a large business delegation, is likely to focus largely on boosting India-US economic engagement.

title: Oregon backyard hobby grew into world's longest miniature railway, 32 miles
content: Oregon hobbyist Ed St. John started building a railroad in his backyard . his project, called the Over-the-Hill Live Steamers, attracted volunteers from nearby Medford . the railroad is the world's longest rideable miniature hobby railway .

title: Taylor Swift reclaimed her first six albums; 2026 deal reveals who owns her hit songs
content: HarbourView Equity Partners acquired the publisher’s share of selected compositions written by Wolf Cousins . the deal included two Swift hits, Style and ...Ready for It? . it did not affect Swift’s existing ownership of the recordings or transfer her own songwriting share .

title: ‘Deeply regrettable’: Sanjay Raut’s Albania arson post draws flak from party colleague
content: Priyanka Chaturvedi disagrees with her party colleague for suggesting that India should learn a lesson from the student-led protests in Albania . she claimed that people in Albania had set the country's Supreme Court ablaze for allegedly helping corrupt prime ministers . the protesting public has also attacked parliament and government offices, as well as ministers' homes .

title: Bangladesh furious as Saudi prison list omitted death sentences for 2 citizens
content: two of its citizens, Nazrul Islam and Sweety Akhter, were executed in mecca on October 14 without prior notification to dhaka . the government has questioned why their death sentences were missing from a list of convicted nationals sent by Saudi authorities on September 30 .

title: Jensen Huang and his wife donated $75 million to Vanderbilt
Annamalai backs CJP leaders, questions their continued custody
content: former BJP president questioned police's handling of the case . he said that continued judicial custody of CJP leaders raises concerns about the rule of law . "i'm afraid of saying that the police are doing a real disservice," he added .

title: Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman visits 3 cities to extend Durga Puja greetings to Hindus
content: prime minister visited a Puja mandap in Rangpur before joining celebrations at JM Sen Hall in Rahmatganj, Chattogram . he called for a peaceful and harmonious environment where people of all faiths can live together for generations .

title: Keith Haring mural once hidden behind drywall now in New York's $25m loft
content: the unsigned mural is the centrepiece of an extraordinary Tribeca property . it survived a change of occupants, a restaurant conversion and years of concealment . the artist created the monochrome mural in 1979 while studying at the school of visual arts .
